ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white ventral surface bounded by approximately 30% low-intensity black trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; irregular black border along the trailing edges with a feathered, dendritic interface. A distinct circular low-intensity focal spot is visible on the medial-right lobe, with smaller punctate black spots scattered across the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate internal pixel angle of 50-55 degrees with significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, showing coarse jagged peaks compared to the smoother outer-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, following a symmetrical lateral sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white, circular nodes (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several faint, low-contrast circular depressions visible on the interior white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the outer distal tips; one prominent circular dark ring scar on the mid-right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation on the left trailing edge exhibits a wider, more irregular vertical intrusion into the white field compared to the narrower, more linear black border on the right lobe.
